title: Grade 10 — the bridge from analytical core to AP Lang
spine: ACC-aligned, introducing AP writing skills (per the learning-science read: G10 stays ACC but starts the AP ramp)

provenance.source: Derived 2026-09-15 as the diff between the AP Lang CED skill dependencies and the mapped G9 graph
provenance.note: Every skill here is a PROPOSED bridge claim pending learning-science review. The gaps command computes which of these the AP bands depend on; a reviewer decides whether each belongs in G10 or moves.

skills.title: Analyze a full rhetorical situation (speaker, purpose, audience, context, exigence)
skills.rationale: G9 teaches choice-spotting inside a text; AP requires reading every choice as a response to a situation outside the text. Nothing in G9 models situation-driven analysis.

skills.title: Build one argument from multiple provided sources, citing at least three
skills.rationale: The AP synthesis FRQ has no G9 ancestor: G9 evidence work is single-source. Multi-source positioning (sources that disagree, a visual source) is a new skill, not a harder version of an old one.

skills.title: Qualify a claim and answer the strongest counterargument on its merits
skills.rationale: G9 L04 introduces counterarguments; AP argument essays reward calibrated claims (concession, qualification, rebuttal) as a habit, which is the seed of Row C sophistication.

skills.title: Write a timed rhetorical-analysis essay on an unseen passage
skills.rationale: G9 builds every ingredient (choice audit, S-F-E chains, analytical paragraphs) but never assembles them into the timed whole-essay form the FRQ demands.

skills.title: Evaluate a source's position and credibility; attribute it cleanly
skills.rationale: Synthesis sources arrive with agendas. G9 attribution is mechanical (name the source); AP requires reading what a source is doing before enlisting it.

skills.title: Read pre-20th-century argumentative prose with fluency
skills.rationale: AP passages routinely predate 1900 (Chesterfield, Banneker, Adams). Stamina on period syntax and diction is a ramp, and it must start before G11.
